mineral_product.label: Mineral / product
mineral_product.value: Salt, sulfate of potash plant nutrients, and magnesium chloride.

extraction_route.label: Extraction route
extraction_route.value: Underground rock salt mining, solution mining for evaporated salt, and Great Salt Lake brine harvesting for salt, sulfate of potash, and magnesium chloride.

beneficiation_processing.label: Beneficiation / processing
beneficiation_processing.value: Rock salt crushing and screening, mechanical and solar evaporation for salt, and solar brine concentration for sulfate of potash and magnesium chloride.

delivery_radius_logistics.value: Distribution primarily in North America, with production and packaging facilities in the U.S., Canada, and the U.K.
